page.notes: Doubtful readings: "praeuêti" (the accent on e is uncertain); "quoq; ue" (the word after quoq; is unclear); "sentier[?]"; "dusturus[?]" (a stray mark stands between dusturus and procul); "dubio" (final letter uncertain); "nec" (printed form could be "nee"); "ʒ" in "ʒ.cap.Eccl." (number form uncertain); the final letter of "replete" is damaged and possibly not e. Word "colendae" is printed as "colen" / "dae" across a line end without a hyphen, so it is written whole. The "2" that opens the second paragraph is a paragraph number, not a heading.
